content:
An off-duty U.S. Border Patrol agent was arrested on a driving while intoxicated charge after a three-vehicle crash in Laredo, according to KGNS.

The agent was driving in the 5600 block of San Bernardo Avenue, near San Dario Avenue, when he allegedly struck another vehicle, causing a chain reaction involving three vehicles, KGNS reported. The crash happened around 2 a.m. The driver and another person were taken to a hospital.

Laredo police said alcohol was a factor in the crash and that the agent failed an intoxication test, according to KGNS. He was charged with driving while intoxicated.

U.S. Border Patrol said the agent is an off-duty agent assigned to the Laredo Sector, that he was placed on administrative leave, and that it declined to release his name pending an investigation, KGNS reported. No driver name was given in the report. The charge is an allegation, and the driver is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.
